summary: Female hiker from Brooklyn, NY sustained a lower leg injury and was assisted by rangers down Dream Lake Trail to Bear Lake, then taken by personal vehicle for further care.
location: Dream Lake Trail, Bear Lake area, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Source: Estes Park News, "Six Incidents in Rocky Mountain National Park on Tuesday, August 14, 2012" — one of six same-day RMNP incidents; the Broadway Ledge pair from the same article is id 3086.
